description.en: Shared exact-integer CPU benchmark contract for Python,C,JavaScript,Aevix and C++.
description.ko: 다섯 언어에서 동일한 정수 계산을 실행하는 CPU 벤치마크 계약이다.

input: values[i]=(i+seed)%4096 for i=0..4095; initialize before each timer; runtime seed0 supplied explicitly by runner, Aevix reads it from stdin before any timers
lcg: x=values[i]%2147483647+1; repeat rounds times: x=(x*48271+1)%2147483647; store x
next_prime: n=1000000001+(values[i]%4096)*1024; test odd divisors d=3,5,... while d*d<=n; if composite n+=2 and retry; store the first prime
arithmetic: All operations and checksums are exact integers below2^53 in every implementation. Native/Aevix/Python data use uint64 values; JS uses Float64Array. No fast math or approximate kernel.
checksums: sum(values); weighted checksum h=0 then h=(h+(i+1)*values[i])%1000000007 for each i
partition: W=min(online logical CPUs,32,4096). W contiguous chunks: quotient plus one for first remainder chunks. Launch W-1 workers; caller runs final chunk; join all before stop timer.

parallel_backends.Python: multiprocessing spawn with shared uint64 array; parent executes last chunk
parallel_backends.JavaScript: worker_threads with SharedArrayBuffer Float64Array; parent executes last chunk

measurement.timed: kernel execution including per-call worker/process startup and joins; excludes input initialization, checksums, output and executable/process startup
measurement.run_order: rotate language/program order across isolated invocations; one benchmark at a time
measurement.output: SAMPLE <case> <mode> <sample_index> <elapsed_ns> <sum> <weighted> <workers>; print VERIFY <case> <mode> <comma-separated4096values> once outside timing for exact comparison

anti_elision: Every final4096value is observed outside timing; runtime opaque input seed prevents compile-time full input precomputation. Inspect optimizedIR for motion across timer calls; no unsupported black_box/volatile syntax assumed.
